d: Telangana sarkar dvara haidrabad ke aitihasik NTR stediyam men 'sadar' utsav (Sadar Festival) ka bhavy aayojan kiya gaya. is sanskritik evan paranprik utsav men telangana ke mukhyamantri e. revant reddi aur rashtriy janta dal (RJD) ke varishth neta va bihar ke purv up-mukhyamantri tejasvi yadav samet kaee pramukh netaon ne shirkat ki.
